narrative:
## Handover Summary — Feed Ingestion & Completeness

All 12 close feeds are landed and checked against the Business Central trial balance. Missing posting periods were backfilled from the Data Lake replica, so no manual extraction was needed.

## Key Decisions
• Paged BC extraction with Data Lake fallback became the standard path for GL and intercompany
• Late East stock-count batches were re-ingested after the cut-off
• Completeness certified by the Group Financial Controller at WD+1

## Recommendation for Reconciliation
Start with Supplier Invoices & Rebates and Store-Owner Intercompany. Together they hold NOK 44M of the NOK 84.7M unmatched value.

signals.title: September close — Business Central API time-outs
signals.excerpt: The Business Central API could not handle the data volume during the first month-end close on the new ERP. Finance fell back to extracting from the Data Lake to finish the close.

signals.title: New POS roll-out — cut-over plan
signals.excerpt: POS replacement rolling out chain by chain alongside the Business Central implementation with Tietoevry. Item master moves to EAN; settlement files change format at cut-over.
